skill_name: Create an engaging blog post giving advice on how to prepare for job interviews.
workflow: Job interviews can be a stressful and anxiety-inducing experience, but with the right preparation, they can be a breeze! The most important thing when preparing for a job interview is to be well prepared. Take the time to read up on the company, its mission, and its culture. It is also important to be aware of commonly asked questions so that you can better prepare your responses.
